<!-- pr-reviewer: b51e8991fb702d42ff71da9fe2fc020f99380c96 -->
**Needs a rebase - not built.** A trial merge of this head with current `origin/main` conflicts, so I did not build or test it. Thanks for the PR; once it merges cleanly it gets a full review.

Conflicting files:

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` - two spots. Module list (~line 35): this PR adds `mod debug_info;`, main added `mod stock_info;` (keep both). Test module list (~line 110): this PR adds `mod debug_info_tests;`, main added `mod fresh_op_tests;`, `mod tool_number_tests;` and `mod gate_route_tests;` (keep all, each with its `#[cfg(test)]`).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` (~line 651, end of the window-drawing function): this PR calls `super::debug_info::window(ui.ctx(), state);`, main added `unsaved_prompt::window(ui.ctx(), state);` (#107). Keep both; the unsaved prompt stays last so it sits over everything.
- `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` (~lines 37 and 56): this PR extends the "Original artwork" heading and the "Tabler Icons ... except" file list with `debug-info.png`; main changed the same two lines (new glyphs listed). Take main's lines and add `debug-info.png`; the "twelve glyphs" count in the prose below likely needs updating too.
- `RECOMMENDED.md`: conflicts with main's appended entries; keep both sides.
- `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app.png`, `egui_app_light.png`, `egui_tool_editor.png`: binary, changed on both sides. Take main's versions and regenerate with the UI snapshot suite (run with CWD `crates/ui`) after the code merge.

Also: `CHANGELOG.md` edits should not be in the PR (not touched here, good). The orange `conflicts` label stays until this is resolved.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 58cab1f0ed568c0390a0cd16f26fa072eb716e46 -->
**Needs a branch refresh: the code is good, but GitHub reports this PR as CONFLICTING (mergeStateStatus DIRTY).**

**What looks good**
- Debug info window and button are ephemeral view state (`State::debug_info_open`, `gpu_line`), so no command is needed. No unwrap/expect/panic in `debug_info.rs`.
- Headless frames and a failed icon decode fall back to a text "Debug info" button.
- `debug-info.png` is original artwork and is listed in `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` (thirteen glyphs, both lists updated). Provenance line present. No `.github`, `build.rs`, script or dependency change in the PR's own diff.
- The decision file is at `docs/decisions/157-debug-info.md`. The PR body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #157`.
- Snapshots: I read `egui_app.png` and `egui_app_light.png`. The only visible change is the status strip. The long status line is cut with "…" and the bug glyph sits at the far right. It is visible on the light theme, so the tint fix works. The full text stays available on hover and in "Copy message", so a refusal or alert is still readable.

**Local results** (trial merge with current origin/main 8cf3c90; #213 is already in main; the merge was clean, no conflicts; `cargo` run in the worktree)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`, includes snapshots, debug_info_tests, status/alert tests) | 279 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. GitHub still shows the PR as conflicting, even though `git merge-tree` against origin/main 8cf3c90 comes out clean for me. The cause is probably the multiple merge bases from the partial merges of #213 and #251. A plain `git merge origin/main` on the branch should clear it, if the push token allows the `.github` changes (the earlier refresh avoided them for that reason). The maintainer can instead resolve it at merge time.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `docs/decisions/157-debug-info.md` still says "no logging framework yet - #163". Tracing has landed in #222, so including recent log lines could be a follow-up.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs` is about 1985 lines and grew by about 12. It is already far over the ~400 limit; splitting the status strip out would help later.
- Snapshot PNGs were committed from another OS, so pixel diffs there are a platform artifact. The match on this OS is confirmed by the passing snapshot tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
